subject: POC working session — sequencing, prompt review, routing & load plan
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Rivera <emma@novara.ai>, Kyle Torres <kyle@novara.ai>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 20 Jul 2025 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: POC working session — sequencing, prompt review, routing & load plan

Hi Emma / Kyle —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. To keep momentum on the POC, we'd like to run a 75–90 minute hands-on working session where we: 
- walk through the initial prompt set with your product team (prompt engineering + scoring)
- review routing rules (latency vs cost tiers) and fallback behavior
- run a short load plan (baseline throughput + token distribution) and capture perf traces

Proposed slot: Wed Jul 23, 11:00 AM PDT (2:00 PM EDT) — remote meeting, we’ll share a live sandbox and a short harness for the load run.

Draft agenda attached (draft-session-agenda.pdf) and a candidate prompt list (sample-prompts.txt) — can you confirm: 
1) who from Novara will join (dev lead + PM ideally)?
2) any hard constraints on timing or attendees?
3) expected average prompt length (tokens) and target concurrent sessions for the load run?

If that slot doesn't work, flag alternatives and we’ll adjust. Goal is to leave the session with an agreed throughput target and an owner for the follow-up full-scale run.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Thanks Connor — appreciate the clear agenda. Quick scheduling note: Wed Jul 23 at 11:00 PDT conflicts with our all-hands. Would you be able to move to Thu Jul 24 morning (our side prefers before 12:00 PM EDT) or Tue Jul 22 after 3:00 PM EDT?

Attendees we plan to include: Liam Chen (lead backend engineer), Sara Morales (product manager), and myself. Liam will want to validate dev/local access ahead of the sandbox run.

On token lengths — our current average is ~120 tokens per user prompt; we can generate a couple of longer edge-case prompts (~700 tokens) if that helps for spike testing.

—Emma

Hi Emma —

Thanks for the heads up. We can move the session to Thu Jul 24 at 09:30 AM PDT (12:30 PM EDT) or keep Wed Jul 23 but shift to 11:15 AM PDT if that helps — Connor and I prefer Thu 24 at 09:30 PDT to avoid overlap with other internal meetings.

Confirming Novara attendees (from your note): Liam Chen, Sara Morales, Emma Rivera. Connor will lead the prompt review and I’ll run routing/fallback demos. Dev_Patel (cc'd) will run the short load plan during the session.

To size the load run, can you confirm the target concurrency? From experience, a pragmatic ramp is: 5 -> 25 -> 75 concurrent sessions (30s steady-state per level) using the 120-token average and one 700-token spike. If you have a different sequence or want longer steady-state windows, let us know. I attached a simple template (load_plan.xlsx) to capture the agreed profile.

If Thu 24 09:30 PDT works, Connor / I will send a calendar invite and pre-reqs (API keys + sandbox access checklist) by EOD today.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: POC working session — sequencing, prompt review, routing & load plan — recap & next steps

Hi all — thanks again for joining yesterday’s working session (recording link below). Short recap and owner-level action items to keep momentum: 

Recording: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1session-recording-20250723
Shared notes/attack plan: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-novara-poc

What we achieved:
- Completed prompt walkthrough and agreed on scoring rubric for high/medium/low output quality.
- Validated routing rules for latency-sensitive vs cost-optimized buckets; confirmed fallback to smaller quantized model for overflow.
- Ran ramped micro-load (5 -> 25 -> 75) using 120-token average and one 700-token spike; captured traces and token-level latency.

Action items (owner — due):
1) Build test harness with batching parameters (batch size targets + token cap) — dev_patel@redwood.ai — due 2025-07-28
2) Produce trimmed perf report (P95, P99, avg tokens/sec by model variant) — Connor O'Brien — due 2025-07-27
3) Implement routing fallback experiments in sandbox and share config diff — Stephanie Nguyen — due 2025-07-29
4) Novara: validate sandbox auth and provide any outstanding edge-case prompts (3 examples) — Liam Chen / Sara Morales — due 2025-07-25
5) Schedule full-throughput automated run (target: 500 concurrent sessions) — joint call to lock date: propose Tue Jul 29 or Wed Jul 30 — owners: Connor + Novara Eng (pick date by 2025-07-26)

Attachments: session-recording-20250723.mp4 (uploaded to Drive), trimmed traces (in Drive folder), load_plan.xlsx (attached earlier).

Next immediate step: Liam / Sara, can you confirm sandbox auth by EOD Jul 25 and send the three edge-case prompts? Once we have that, Dev will finalize the harness and we’ll run the full throughput test the week of Jul 28/29.

Thanks — great collaboration.

Connor O'Brien
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
